تواكلت (form VI)
# تَوَاكَلْتُ (tawākaltu) /ta.waː.kal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# تَوَاكَلْتَ (tawākalta) /ta.waː.kal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# تَوَاكَلْتِ (tawākalti) /ta.waː.kal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَاكَلَ (tawākala)
# تَوَاكَلَتْ (tawākalat) /ta.waː.ka.lat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
